up: Show exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649957, including their canonical SMILES. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Use exact values only (standard_relation = '='). Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649957' AND a.standard_relation = '='
